manifest.description: Read current local Git facts without shell or repository writes. snapshot (default) returns origin, branch, full HEAD, latest commit and tracked/untracked status; status returns working-tree state; log returns up to limit commits. Detached/unborn HEAD, truncation and changes during sampling are explicit. This is a timed observation, not an atomic snapshot. Submodules are counted but never inspected recursively. External content filters are disabled; filtersDisabled means status counts reflect this restricted observation. clean is null when a clean claim cannot be established. Use this in read-only work instead of bash/git commands or parsing .git files. It does not fetch or prove the remote is current. Use read_file on artifactPath for omitted entries; do not treat truncated output as complete.

path.description: Repository directory, absolute or relative to the workspace.

limit.description: Maximum status entries or commits returned inline. Counts cover the observed top-level status; disabled external filters and uninspected submodules are explicit.

provenance: Actual legacy TS GitRead and LocalGitProvider over real synthetic Git repositories; system configuration isolated by test-only Git wrapper. No Node/Bun engine is shipped.
